g.text: Proposed connections; amber blocks/bundles contain unresolved interfaces.
Wire colors: W01 convention, NOT factory pigtail evidence. Blank color = complete USB cable; see schedule.

g.title: USB_SOURCE
g.text: ONE USB source at a time

g.title: W_USB
g.text: Complete USB cable, NOT one conductor.
Native USB: left front view / USB label; COM unused.
Computer cable must support data; source/load capacity Q12.

g.title: J1
g.text: L = front-view left row, top to bottom (P01).
USB_NATIVE is a whole-port symbol, not a contact.
YD-family assumption Q30: IN-OUT closed; USB-OTG open.
GPIOs Q14; physical rail/load checks Q05/Q12.

g.title: W_RAIL
g.text: Carrier feeds: L1 3V3, L22 GND, L21 nominal 5 V.
IN-OUT closed; USB-OTG open; family assumption Q30.
5 V is after USB input diode; voltage/load checks Q05/Q12.
Length (mm), termination and substitutions: as-built record.

g.title: W_LCD
g.text: Length (mm), termination and color substitutions: as-built record.

g.title: W_BUTTON
g.text: GPIO6 candidate Q14; wire to real contact pair.
Length (mm), termination and color substitutions: as-built record.

g.title: W_I2C_LV
g.text: ESP32 3.3 V I2C to LS1 LV1/LV2.

g.title: RAILS
g.text: Net names, NOT physical connector pins.
3V3 and 5V are distinct supplies; never bridge them.
One USB source; common return; load budget Q12.

g.title: W_LCD_PWR
g.text: J2:VCC:3.3 V module supply selected Q31
Selected 3.3 V display power Q31; listing range 3-5 V.
Current/backlight and regulator margin checks Q06/Q12.
Length (mm), termination and substitutions: as-built record.

g.title: W_ADC
g.text: J3:V:5 V shared with FTP sensor
Shared 5 V ADC power and LS1 HV1/HV2 bus.
Length (mm), termination and substitutions: as-built record.

g.title: W_ADDR
g.text: Inspect existing bias before fitting Q08/Q18.
Length (mm), termination and color substitutions: as-built record.

g.title: W_FTP_PWR
g.text: P04: GM-family map assumed; C=5 V, A=return.
USB-fed L21 with IN-OUT closed; voltage/load checks Q05/Q12.
Q09: check lead mapping/fit at assembly.
Colors apply to added leads, NOT factory pigtail.
Length (mm), termination and substitutions: as-built record.

g.title: W_ANALOG_GND
g.text: C1 return to common analog reference.
Length (mm), termination and substitutions: as-built record.

g.title: W_LS_REF
g.text: Selected module LV/HV supplies and both GND pads.
No enable pin; bring-up Q29; selected source Q30; load checks Q12.

g.title: J2
g.text: P05: screen side, tab down, left to right.
Vendor supply range 3-5 V; use 3.3 V logic and VCC.
SPI labels SDA/SCL are NOT I2C.

g.title: J3
g.text: P03: BACK view, mounting holes up, left to right.
Q07/Q08: identity, pull-ups and bias checks.
5 V ADC bus connects through LS1, never directly to J1.

g.title: LS1
g.text: SOLDER/BACK view: HV row above LV row.
Each row listed left to right; component view mirrored.
GND_HV/GND_LV: aliases for pads marked GND.

g.title: S1
g.text: Functional contact pair, not package pin numbers.
Identify two contacts open until pressed.
Internal GPIO pull-up planned; no external supply.

g.title: FTP
g.text: P04: PIGTAIL mating face, latch up: A B C left to right.
GM reference map adopted for listed replacement.
Q09: as-built lead/fit check; Q10: calibration.
Sensor mating face is mirrored; do not copy left/right.

g.title: W_RAW
g.text: FTP B signal to RC filter IN.
R1/C1 circuit in rc-input-filter component guide.
BN applies to added lead, NOT factory pigtail.
Length (mm), termination and substitutions: as-built record.

g.title: COND
g.text: Built RC input filter - 470 ohm / 1 uF
IN -- R1 470 ohm -- OUT; C1 1 uF from OUT to GND.
Nonpolar capacitor, rated at least 10 V; no supply pin.
Node names, NOT physical connector pin numbers.
Nominal cutoff 339 Hz; built near A0.
No divider or fault clamp; power/protection review Q17.

g.title: W_A0
g.text: Keep short; input stays within ADC GND to VDD.
Length (mm), termination and substitutions: as-built record.
